wu2023gnnnlp.findings: Organises GNN-for-NLP work by graph construction, representation learning and encoder-decoder models (abstract not retrieved; title and venue only)

jin2024llmgraphs.method: Survey: LLMs on pure, text-attributed and text-paired graphs; LLM as predictor, encoder, aligner
jin2024llmgraphs.datasets: Summarises open-source code and benchmark datasets
jin2024llmgraphs.findings: States that whether LLM text reasoning generalises to graphs is underexplored (abstract)

phan2023fakesurvey.method: Survey of GNN methods for fake news detection
phan2023fakesurvey.findings: Abstract not read; cited as evidence that the area is surveyed

gong2023fakesurvey.method: Survey: knowledge-driven, propagation-based and heterogeneous social-context graph methods for fake news detection
gong2023fakesurvey.findings: Discusses challenges and open problems of graph-based fake news detection (abstract)

he2023tape.method: TAPE: prompt an LLM (the repository distributes 'GPT responses'; exact model version not checked) for zero-shot predictions plus explanations; an LM interprets them into node features for a GNN
he2023tape.datasets: Cora, PubMed, ogbn-arxiv, tape-arxiv23 (repository calls it arxiv_2023)
he2023tape.findings: State-of-the-art on these TAG datasets and 2.88x faster training than the closest baseline on ogbn-arxiv (abstract)
he2023tape.limitations: Repository LM example uses 4 GPUs; environment pinned to PyTorch 1.12.1 / CUDA 11.3; precomputed GPT responses are provided for download (README, read 2026-10-17)

zolnai2024stage.method: STAGE: use pre-trained LLMs only as embedding generators for node text, then ensemble GNNs
zolnai2024stage.datasets: Node classification benchmarks (not named in abstract)
zolnai2024stage.findings: Competitive results with a simpler pipeline than multi-stage prompting methods (abstract)

chen2024exploring.method: Systematic study of LLMs-as-Enhancers and LLMs-as-Predictors for node classification
chen2024exploring.datasets: Cora, PubMed, ogbn-arxiv, ogbn-products and others
chen2024exploring.findings: Section 7.1 Finding 3 (full text): a potential test data leakage problem on ogbn-arxiv; LLM-as-predictor evaluation used 200 sampled test nodes because of API cost
chen2024exploring.limitations: Section 7.2/7.3 (full text): querying LLM APIs at least N times for N nodes makes large graphs costly; test data may appear in LLM training corpora

huang2023leakage.method: Curates a leakage-free dataset (arxiv-2023, test nodes are 2023 arXiv CS papers) and compares LLM prompting with and without structure
huang2023leakage.datasets: arxiv-2023 (33,868 nodes, 305,672 edges, per repository README), ogbn-arxiv, Cora, PubMed
huang2023leakage.findings: No substantial evidence that LLM performance is due to data leakage; LLMs read neighbourhood prompts as context paragraphs; label-relevant phrases help most (abstract)
huang2023leakage.limitations: Repository template targets ChatGPT through the OpenAI API only; no licence stated (README)

li2024glbench.method: GLBench: benchmark of GraphLLM methods vs GNN baselines with consistent splits, supervised and zero-shot
li2024glbench.findings: LLM-as-enhancer methods most robust; LLM-as-predictor less effective; no clear scaling law; a simple zero-shot baseline beats several tailored models (abstract)

wu2025llmnodebed.method: LLMNodeBed: codebase and testbed, 8 LLM-based algorithms incl. TAPE, 8 classic baselines, 3 learning paradigms, >2,700 models
wu2025llmnodebed.datasets: 10 homophilic + 4 heterophilic TAGs (Cora, Citeseer, Pubmed, arXiv, WikiCS, Instagram, Reddit, Books, Photo, Computer, Cornell, Texas, Wisconsin, Washington)
wu2025llmnodebed.findings: LLM methods help clearly in semi-supervised settings, marginally in supervised ones (abstract). Full text: TAPE uses Mistral-7B by default; replacing it with GPT-4o helps by up to 4% on Pubmed semi-supervised and the gap narrows with supervision; TAPE took 5.9 h on Pubmed on one H100-80G
wu2025llmnodebed.limitations: Conclusion (full text): limited exploration of LLMs on heterophilic graphs and scarcity of text-rich heterophilic datasets. No discussion of training-data leakage found in the full text

luo2024classic.method: Re-tunes GCN, GAT, GraphSAGE against graph transformers on 18 datasets
luo2024classic.findings: Classic GNNs with light tuning match or beat graph transformers on 17 of 18 datasets (abstract)

dai2021syntax.method: Compares parser trees with trees induced from fine-tuned RoBERTa inside ABSA graph models (ASGCN, PWCN, RGAT); plain RoBERTa baseline
dai2021syntax.datasets: Six ABSA datasets in four languages
dai2021syntax.findings: FT-RoBERTa induced trees beat parser trees; a pure RoBERTa model outperforms or approximates previous SOTA (abstract)
dai2021syntax.limitations: Official repository has no licence and no seed control was found by the automated check; last push 2023-03-08

li2024sebert.method: SE-BERT: syntax-enhanced transformer layers replacing BERT's final layers
li2024sebert.findings: Abstract states that existing methods improve aspect-level sentiment classification by adding syntactic GCN layers on BERT

fei2022absarobust.method: Universal-syntax GCN plus synthetic data and adversarial/contrastive training for ABSA robustness
fei2022absarobust.findings: Strong in-house ABSA models generalise poorly to challenging contexts (abstract)

dou2021upfd.method: UPFD: joint news content and user-engagement graph modelling with GNNs
dou2021upfd.datasets: UPFD PolitiFact (314 graphs, 157 fake) and GossipCop (5,464 graphs, 2,732 fake), per repository README
dou2021upfd.findings: Releases code and data as a benchmark for GNN-based fake news detection (abstract)
dou2021upfd.limitations: README states no run count, split or seed; repository licence Apache-2.0

kim2025dawn.method: Temporality-aware evaluation of social-graph fake news detection; DAWN edge reweighting by engagement earliness
kim2025dawn.findings: Conventional methods lose discriminative power sharply when trained only on data available up to a point in time (abstract)

gong2024csda.method: CSDA: causal propagation substructures for out-of-domain fake news detection
gong2024csda.findings: 7-16% accuracy improvement on OOD fake news (abstract)

mavromatis2024gnnrag.method: GNN-RAG: a GNN (ReaRev) retrieves answer candidates from a KG subgraph; shortest paths are verbalised for an LLM reader
mavromatis2024gnnrag.findings: Full text: tuned LLaMA2-Chat-7B reader reaches WebQSP Hit 85.7 / F1 71.3; Table 5 shows retrieval also lifts Flan-T5-xl (WebQSP Hit 31.0 to 74.5)
mavromatis2024gnnrag.limitations: Full text: assumes the KG subgraph contains the answer nodes; entity-linking errors and disconnected KG parts give empty paths. GNN runs used an RTX-3090 with 128 GB RAM; LLM runs used 4 A100 GPUs

um2026rporag.method: RPO-RAG: relation-aware preference optimisation and answer-centred prompts for small-LLM KG RAG
um2026rporag.findings: States prior KG-RAG work relies on large LLMs or backbones above 7B, leaving sub-7B models underexplored (abstract)

li2025hetgb.method: HeTGB: benchmark of five heterophilic text-attributed graphs evaluating GNNs, PLMs and co-training
li2025hetgb.findings: Shows utility of text in heterophilic graphs and limits of existing models (abstract)

wu2024llmhetero.method: LLM-enhanced edge discriminator and edge reweighting for heterophilic graphs, with distillation to smaller models
wu2024llmhetero.findings: LLMs can improve node classification on heterophilic graphs (abstract)

platonov2023hetero.method: Critique of heterophily benchmarks; new heterophilous datasets
platonov2023hetero.findings: Duplicate nodes cause train-test leakage; standard GNNs usually beat specialised models on the new datasets (abstract)

lei2024intruding.findings: Title and abstract record retrieved; studied as closest work for the robustness candidate

ma2026poisoning.method: Poisoning attacks on LLM-enhanced GNNs (IEEE S&P 2026)
ma2026poisoning.findings: Title-level match for the robustness candidate

fan2026vulnerability.method: Interpretable multi-dimensional adversarial attack on TAGs (WWW 2026)
fan2026vulnerability.findings: Title-level match for the robustness candidate

lei2025tagrobust.method: Unified robustness evaluation of GNNs, robust GNNs and GraphLLMs under text, structure and hybrid perturbations; SFT-auto defence
lei2025tagrobust.findings: Text-structure robustness trade-offs; GNN robustness depends on the text encoder; GraphLLMs vulnerable to training-data corruption (abstract)

zhao2023rdgcn.method: RDGCN: reinforced dependency GCN for ABSA
zhao2023rdgcn.findings: Example of continued dependency-GCN ABSA work after 2021

huang2025mvasegcn.method: Multi-view attention syntactic enhanced GCN for ABSA
huang2025mvasegcn.findings: Example of continued dependency-GCN ABSA work after 2021
